g.text: do / the Planner or the Owner writes the issue
do / wait for a free slot
do / the Owner reviews the pull request
In every state: the labels of the issue differ from
those of its pull request / copy the labels (I11).
After the issue closed with a merged pull request:
/ write the reason, notify the Owner (I2)
a check does not pass] (no row)
/ request the cause, notify the Owner (I8)
/ post the reason, notify the Owner (I10)
the Owner approved the head commit
A box is a state: a label on GitHub. "do /" is what goes on in the state.
An arrow is a transition: trigger [guard] / effect.
In parentheses: the row of issue-states.md today.
